name: File Size & Responsibility Separation
note: The budget counts code lines, not comments, so the way to pass is to split responsibilities rather than to delete the explanation of why the code is the way it is.

mutations.name: a file is pushed past its code-line budget
mutations.why: The budget is what forces a module to do one thing. A gate that cannot notice growth lets a file quietly become the place everything lands.

mutations.name: code hidden behind a short leading comment
mutations.why: External audit V11. The counter judged a line by how it started, so `/* p */ const x = 1;` counted as a comment. Three hundred such lines added nothing to the count and the file passed at any size.
